about: The browser-level mutants of the REBUILT page. Each is ONE exact-text edit of one file under src/ (find must match exactly once), made in a scratch copy by verification/mutate-new.js, built with vite and run against verify-custom.js on the groups named. A mutant the groups let through is a gap in the suite (SURVIVED); a mutant marked equivalent is a guard nothing in the page can reach and must survive (the reason says why). The ids m01-m79 are the mutants of the old page that verify-custom-mutants.js applies to legacy/index.html (see behaviours-custom.json for the map); the others are named for what they remove.
